title: Signature Study — Echelle spectrometer concept (600 l/mm grating)
description: This is a Signature-authored optical design study for a echelle spectrometer at 600 l/mm grating. Design goals address the real aberration profile: Coma: off-axis rays in the collimator smear the spectral lines. Astigmatism: perpendicular planes focus at different points; the classic Czerny-Turner limitation. Corrected with a coma corrector lens. Intended application: chemistry quality control.

aberration_notes: Coma: off-axis rays in the collimator smear the spectral lines.
